limitations: Cloudflare deploy requires wrangler login on the machine that deploys
Invite is fully offline: join requires full DS1 package or QR
New members do not receive past sessions by default
iOS install is manual via Safari Share → Add to Home Screen
complianceNotes: Optional opt-in Space room relay for shared data only (VITE_SPACE_RELAY_URL)
Manual DSX1 export/import remains backup path
Bible text limited to public domain KJV
No user accounts — device keys + room codes for MVP relay

finalPolish.name: Offline Experience Hardening + Cloudflare Deployment
finalPolish.notes: dexie-react-hooks live queries on Space timeline + dashboard; schema migrations module + MIGRATIONS.md; session timeline pagination; Storage used in Settings; offline banner + /offline page; SW navigateFallback; Cloudflare _headers/_redirects/wrangler.toml/DEPLOYMENT.md; deployable for testing

finalPolish.name: Space Templates + Freeform Sessions Overhaul
finalPolish.notes: Templates are now a central app concept. Space-level templates: Custom, Guided, Advanced, Freeform. Create Space flow selects template and auto-creates first session. Session notes on every session. Freeform session template (notes + manual passages). Advanced Journey session template. Manual passage logging improved (book datalist, verse range, study notes). Change space template later with confirmation. Schema v4 migration for spaceTemplate/defaultSessionTemplateId + notes defaults. Existing session templates preserved (Discipleship Start, Weekly Study, Book Study).

featureNotes.manualPassageLogging: book + chapter + verse range + study notes without Bible reader

cloudflarePages.releaseNotes: Full pilot: UX P0–P2, relay, feedback, KJV+WEB with offline cache tips, free-forever mission

nextPhase: Deploy space-relay Worker + set VITE_SPACE_RELAY_URL; opportunistic auto-sync; custom domain when product-ready; GrokDocs / GrokLaw
